summary.oneLiner: Manufacturer of woven, coated and laminated synthetic (engineered) fabrics and finished aerospace and defence solutions.
summary.business: Kusumgar makes over 1,000 SKUs of high-performance engineered fabrics based on polyamide/polyester filaments and polyurethane chemistry, and has expanded into finished aerospace and military products such as parachute systems, stealth solutions and rapid-deployment systems. It serves four segments: Aerospace and Defence Fabrics, Aerospace and Defence Solutions, Industrial and Automotive Fabrics, and Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics, selling to Indian government and private integrators in India and via exports.

currentContext.business: Kusumgar makes over 1,000 SKUs of high-performance engineered fabrics based on polyamide/polyester filaments and polyurethane chemistry, and has expanded into finished aerospace and military products such as parachute systems, stealth solutions and rapid-deployment systems. It serves four segments: Aerospace and Defence Fabrics, Aerospace and Defence Solutions, Industrial and Automotive Fabrics, and Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics, selling to Indian government and private integrators in India and via exports.
currentContext.expansion: Company operates six facilities in Gujarat plus one fabrication unit in Uttar Pradesh; it intends to expand its aerospace product lines (paragliders, sails, hot-air/helium balloons, aerostats), sell its own aerospace/defence systems globally, and build coating/lamination capability for inflatables. The Offer is a pure Offer for Sale, so no fresh capex is funded by the IPO.
